That's right! We're taking part in the Puzzle Fest starting today,  April, 24th - don't miss out on the opportunity to fiddle with our match-3 games full of joy and love! To celebrate this festival we've set up a discount of 50% off!

notes.title: HAPPY VALENTINE'S STORY!
notes.content:
Hi there, friends!

Happy St. Valentine’s Day! Keep your loved ones close. And we proudly provide you with a bonus story!

Valentine’s cabin for three

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/a893db357c7ff61b0d170a44cf1f59697f27c8d4.png

It’s the time we meet Robbie, Wolfgang and Misha again! As Wolfgang can’t decide what is his place in this relationship, Robbie decides it’s time he does, so he rents a cabin where they can spend the holidays all together and have some fun. He’s the core of this threesome, all energetic and playful, how can he not make his boyfriends get along? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/e671ce888f52ce10cbc113b4b056ffe065eb3133.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/be7860362bbb3a107ecbbfc3225755b5e4abbd9f.png

These guys are going to become your OT3 in no time, I promise! Look at how cute they are together, aren’t they? 

And to make your holidays even better, there’s a nice 20% discount, so go ahead pick a copy for your loved ones! Also, reminding you that the point shop got an update with the all new items for your profiles, come check it out.

And at last, I’m reminding you to check our Twitter and Discord every now and then, there are some news for those who'd love to support us more.

That’s all, friends, have a good Valentine’s!

Shane

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/3d99a75b569fbd98d97be7815198ca463fd08839.png

Valentine's next: bonus story!

The love is in the air already, though it's still January, we have to be ready, right? Well, we're working on the bonus story. Old characters will meet you again, in the new diverse plot just in time for the St. Valentine’s Day, romantic story for all the horny boys out there! And I can even give you a hint on who's gonna come back! Do you recognize them? Name them down in the comments! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/05d3ef1d98db9779ff4cbad6694ee55b699775d2.jpg

These are all news for today, don't forget to party with us in our social media! See you soon!

XOXO

Shane

notes.title: DEVLOG: MEET EVAN FROM SNAKE PIT STORY!
notes.content:
Hey, friends!

Shane here, bringing you more info as the time goes and release date is a little bit closer with every second! The team is working hard to make Furry Shades Of Gay 2 as cool and hot as possible, and they let me show you some early development materials, but shh… it’s a secret (just kidding, tell everyone!)


Meet Evan!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/7617b49845c7a1c730da09ebe615d2876faee614.png
Evan is a slightly shy fennec fox on his way to serve the master he’s met back on the Internet. The master is going to teach him how to be a good sub, and the session will be unforgettable. You won’t remain indifferent to Evan’s pleading submissive gaze!


Multiple paths lead to multiple releases!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/3e321f4b740fbf665b587988bde296c7f6f7ffe3.png
Is Evan going to experience the art of Shibari or is he going to try on a nice leather bondage? Guide him all the way to the end and help him become a really good boy. 


­­­­Now, let me show you some more stuff from early development, there are some really juicy sketches!
Evan’s Master surely knows how to make his boy behave. He’s strong, mysterious, and won’t let Evan step out of line.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/18cdf64c2e8f3a726629795474713e5001df1044.png


We’ve done some serious research and even consulted a pro in the field to make sure our artworks are accurate and represent the safe practices of Shibari!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/c8803ef525b8047ec35929c184e5858a727c4cab.jpg


And that's enough teasing for now. Please let me remind you that you can add Furry Shades of Gay 2 to your wishlist to get notified when the game is released. Please also Follow the game so you won't miss other dev logs with the hottest sneak peeks!

Don’t forget to subscribe to our social media, including community hub on Steam, because we’re going to bring you some more exciting news from the fields very soon.

Thank you for your support and love, it means a lot to every member of our team.

Join our Twitter to get the latest news

Enter our Discord server to meet new friends
https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

Love,
Shane from Furlough Games Team
